scope: Synthetic four-channel current input, not camera vision. Continuous Go2 simulation with no neural/body reset between stages; test teacher input is zero. Structural cap .10 on the shared compressed route is an explicit prior, not learned or hidden.

summary.evidence_limits: Five seeds vary initial joint noise and parent association wiring; new feature geometry is fixed. Unequal route caps and unequal edge counts are declared priors. This is synthetic input conditioning; testing reads learned weights with learn=False and is not long-term continuous-learning evidence.
